en: A sepia-toned photographic portrait of a young woman with dark hair styled in an early 20th-century fashion, wearing draped white clothing. There is handwritten Greek script in black ink across the top right. On the right margin, vertically, there is printed text in both Greek and French identifying the woman as Chryssoula (Chrysoula) Kotopouli of the Theatre Royal. The word 'Athens' is included.
